reachable: conditional - HTTP 403 (Apache 'Forbidden') when sent the browser Chrome User-Agent from the brief; HTTP 200 with curl's default User-Agent (no UA override). Behind Cloudflare + Varnish.
platform: Magento 2 (theme frontend/Abra/theme, configurable products with per-finish child SKUs)
catalog_endpoint: No public machine-readable catalog: /sitemap.xml 404 (robots.txt references it but it is missing), /graphql 403 (nginx), /rest/default/V1/products 401. Use HTML: category listings https://abralighting.com/{ceiling-lighting,indoor-wall,outdoor-wall}.html?p=N (12/page) -> product pages; each product page embeds Magento swatch jsonConfig with child {entity, sku} and 'images':{entity_id:[{full,img,thumb}]}.
est_products: ~292 configurable parent listings (ceiling-lighting 118 items, indoor-wall 89, outdoor-wall 85; may overlap) expanding to child SKUs per finish - consistent with 529 SKUs.
sku_format_match: yes - child SKUs on site are exactly the sample format (e.g. 50117ODW-MB, 20021WV-BA, 10023PN-BA); parent SKU is the base (50117ODW). Image file names also embed the lowercase child SKU (e.g. 50117odw-mb_hero.jpg).
recommended_strategy: Crawl the 3 top category listings (?p=1..N, ~25 pages total, no layered-nav params - those are robots-disallowed) with default curl UA to collect product URLs; fetch each product page (~300) at <=1 req/s, parse the jsonConfig: map child sku -> entity id, then 'images'[entity] -> 'full' URLs (strip ?store=... for original). Match SKUs exactly (uppercase). Simple (non-configurable) pages: use the gallery 'full' URLs / itemprop sku. Fallback: image filenames start with lowercase SKU.
blockers: Browser-like UA gets 403 (WAF rule) - must use non-browser UA; /catalogsearch/ disallowed in robots.txt; no sitemap, GraphQL blocked, REST requires auth. Robots.txt notes a 2026-07 'layered-navigation flood incident' - crawl gently.
